_comment: Project-level rally auto-coordination hooks for Codex. Ships WITH the repo (works on any user machine, no ~/.codex global change). The command resolves the repo root via git so the path is portable. The hook self-gates on .rally/ presence and fail-opens. Advisory by default; RALLY_HOOK_STRICT=1 to hard-block. Codex prompts to trust on first use. Cadence parity with Claude: SessionStart=enter, UserPromptSubmit=per-turn presence refresh (idle), PreToolUse=before-write, Stop=after-write. See docs/AUTO-COORDINATION-HOOKS.md.
